# Jaivik Overseas Consultants — Study Abroad Portal

> Study-abroad research portal for Indian students, built by Jaivik Overseas
> Consultants (study abroad consultancy, est. 2012, 1,400+ students placed).
> The site's core value is real data: every course, fee, and requirement
> listed is crawled directly from a university's own official course pages —
> never estimated or generated — with a source URL on every listing.

## What data we have

- **30,000+ real courses** crawled from 103 universities across the UK,
  Australia, Canada, Ireland, USA, Germany, Netherlands, New Zealand, and
  more — course name, level, duration, and a direct link to the official
  course page for every entry.
- **Tuition fees converted to INR** from each course's real, published fee
  (native currency shown alongside the INR conversion) — not an estimate or
  average.
- **IELTS/TOEFL/PTE entry requirements** as published per course, where
  available.
- **Post-study work (PSW) visa rules** for the 6 countries with a defined
  post-study work pathway (Canada PGWP, Australia subclass 485, UK Graduate
  Route, Ireland Stamp 1G, Germany job-seeker permit, New Zealand PSW visa).
- **Real city-by-city cost-of-living data** for Canada, UK, and Australia
  (the only three countries with both real tuition and real living-cost data
  on this site).
- Fields without a verifiable source (e.g. visa approval rate, acceptance
  rate, average graduate salary) are explicitly labelled "(Est.)" in the UI
  and excluded from structured data — this site does not present estimates
  as facts.

## Key pages

- Subject guides (real courses by field): /mba-abroad-for-indian-students,
  /computer-science-abroad-for-indian-students,
  /data-science-abroad-for-indian-students,
  /finance-accounting-abroad-for-indian-students
- Cost guides (real tuition + real living costs): /cost-of-studying-in-uk,
  /cost-of-studying-in-australia, /cost-of-studying-in-canada
- Cheapest-university hubs (real fees, sorted): /cheapest-universities-uk,
  /cheapest-universities-australia, /cheapest-universities-canada
- Post-study-work course hubs: /courses-with-psw/canada,
  /courses-with-psw/australia, /courses-with-psw/uk
- University vs. university and country vs. country comparisons:
  /compare/[slug], e.g. /canada-vs-uk-for-mba
- Full university directory: /universities
- Nursing abroad hub: /nursing-abroad
